title: One season, six weeks
description: Every season runs on the same rhythm. At the end every project ships a release and every team gives a demo.

steps.name: Matching
steps.text: Projects are picked, teams are formed, kickoff stream.

steps.name: Discovery
steps.text: Problem statement, architecture decision record, repo skeleton.

steps.name: Foundation
steps.text: CI, test setup and the first vertical slice.

steps.name: Build
steps.text: Features, mid-season demo stream, lots of review.

steps.name: Demo Day
steps.text: v0.1 release, live demo, retro and portfolio cards.
